title: Security, tools, and trust boundaries
subtitle: Connect identities to scopes before exposing knowledge to users or agents.
goal: Make tools and evidence safe to use together
intro: The central risk is turning untrusted language into authority over data or actions.
terms: A change in what may be trusted
Untrusted content attempting to redirect behavior
case: A knowledge article contains instructions to export customer data.
The article can be read as evidence but cannot grant export authority.
A model may obey injected text even when the UI looks harmless.
